name: Tallgrass Permian to Rockies Express Pipeline
researcher_notes: Not an existing row. The closest rows are the Rockies Express Critical Energy Reliability Link Project (P7863, 160 mi, 150 MMcf/d), which is a different project, and the cancelled Permian Global Access and Permian Katy lines. Tallgrass announced in May 2025 a new line of up to 2.4 Bcf/d from the Permian Basin to Rockies Express Zone 2, with anchor shipper agreements, a binding open season in July 2025, and a target in-service date of late 2028. Sponsor and a concrete step are met. Length, route and endpoints in the Permian are not published (Tallgrass press release, Pipeline and Gas Journal May 2025, Natural Gas Intelligence). The 25 km sourced-length rule is not met, so this stays on monitor. Revisit when a FERC pre-filing or application, or a route, appears. Medium confidence.
